qwen38.title: Qwen3.8 27B
qwen38.note: Vanilla hf2q-produced Q4_K_M GGUF (`qwen38-stock/Qwen3.8-27B-vanilla.gguf`). No peer adapter run for this artifact yet.

deepseek4.title: DeepSeek-V4 Flash
deepseek4.note: `deepseek4/…agentic-q2.gguf`. The 2026-08 parity rows used a different artifact (`936a97e6…`); the ADR-063 coding client has no DeepSeek peer adapter.

qwen36.title: Qwen3.6 35B-A3B
qwen36.note: `qwen36-stock-adr063/…Q4_K_M.gguf`, shared by hf2q and peer arms. hf2q fails the N4 coding task, so no speed ratio exists.

gemma4.title: Gemma4 26B-A4B
gemma4.note: hf2q q4_k_m GGUF. The plan marks the Gemma peer adapter unsupported.

qwen38-n4-shared.title: Qwen3.8 N4 shared-production
qwen38-n4-shared.workload: Four-agent coding client, 262144 context, 4 slots. Baseline f6c4adce and candidate a17f7fa1 are siblings on base d0101e00.

qwen38-n4-matched1512.title: Qwen3.8 N4 matched native 0.15.12
qwen38-n4-matched1512.workload: Four-agent coding client; scalar-control baseline f34d3379 vs retained-delta candidate b9b0b6a6, both pinned to mlx-native 0.15.12 (siblings on base d0101e00).

qwen38-n4-traced.title: Qwen3.8 N4 traced
qwen38-n4-traced.workload: Four-agent coding client with the native trace observer (queued demand 128); observer-ON timing equivalence is unproven.

qwen38-n4-pool.title: Qwen3.8 N4 pool ablation
qwen38-n4-pool.workload: Same-binary scratch-pool profile ON vs OFF, five balanced blocks, metric = client coordinator elapsed.

deepseek4-n4-balanced.title: DeepSeek N4 balanced series
deepseek4-n4-balanced.workload: Six balanced four-agent coding cases (parent fee4e0b8 vs memory-span candidate f5b97f33), context 262144, KV budget 8 GiB.

deepseek4-n4-workspace.title: DeepSeek N4 workspace alias
deepseek4-n4-workspace.workload: Four-agent coding client: matched baseline 6d5b9e83 vs workspace-alias candidate 4550f06d, one run each.

qwen36-n4-coding.title: Qwen3.6 N4 coding
qwen36-n4-coding.workload: Four-agent coding client; peer e86 build vs hf2q.

gemma4-n4-full-input.title: Gemma4 N4 full-input
gemma4-n4-full-input.workload: Four-agent coding client with the full-input checkpoint experiment enabled (source 18162bb7).

gemma4-matched-fixed20.title: Gemma4 matched fixed-20 study
gemma4-matched-fixed20.workload: Same binary 18162bb7, checkpoint ON vs OFF, 20 fixed cohorts, 4 slots, 262144 context.
